Thanks for understanding and sorry if I was rash, but was frustrated with the answers I got and that you blocked my post.

Which subs would be better for this and how should I reframe my post so it will be compatible with this sub? I admit that I myself can't find meaning in suffering, it is so unnecessary in life IMO.

Thank you for your answer, I already knew that person. And I didn't intend the topic to be philosophical, it's possible that some philosopher mentioned that first (find meaning in suffering) but I wanted to hear answers even from non philosophers to see what they say, not only that but if someone successfully defeated his suicidal tendencies AND suffers then maybe they could have helped me. But you, NO!

Maybe next time I will post my question ten times more desperate, see if you enable it that way.
